message.content: The case concerns whether operations can close the sign-off for the west entrance at the Oriole Festival setup. The prior assessment found Claim A (zero ticket scans in the first minute) contradicted by gate log S3 showing eight scans, so the entrance was active immediately. Claim C (west entrance opened at 09:00) is well supported by duty log S1. Claim B (six ushers present at 09:00) remains unresolved due to lack of sign-in records, despite the roster assigning six ushers and the coordinator’s assumption of attendance. The key evidence supports that the entrance was open and operational with ticket scans, but usher presence is uncertain. This suggests sign-off can proceed based on entrance activity, though usher attendance is not fully verified.
